en.quote: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?
en.riddle: Hold thy peace, lay thy hand upon thy mouth, and go with us
en.speaker: they said unto him

he.quote: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַחֲרֵשׁ שִׂים-יָדְךָ עַל-פִּיךָ, וְלֵךְ עִמָּנוּ וֶֽהְיֵה-לָנוּ לְאָב וּלְכֹהֵן הֲטוֹב הֱיוֹתְךָ כֹהֵן לְבֵית אִישׁ אֶחָד אוֹ הֱיוֹתְךָ כֹהֵן לְשֵׁבֶט וּלְמִשְׁפָּחָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל
he.speaker: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ
